arguments.content:
import os

try:
    from defusedxml import minidom
except ImportError:
    from xml.dom import minidom

NS = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main"
path = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), "unpacked", "word", "document.xml")

dom = minidom.parse(path)
paras = dom.getElementsByTagNameNS(NS, "p")

headline_count = 0
run_count = 0
headlines = []

for p in paras:
    texts = []
    for t in p.getElementsByTagNameNS(NS, "t"):
        if t.firstChild and t.firstChild.nodeType == t.TEXT_NODE:
            texts.append(t.firstChild.data)
    text = "".join(texts).strip()
    if not text or not any(c.isalpha() for c in text):
        continue
    if text != text.upper():
        continue
    headlines.append(text)
    for r in p.getElementsByTagNameNS(NS, "r"):
        rprs = r.getElementsByTagNameNS(NS, "rPr")
        if rprs:
            rpr = rprs[0]
        else:
            rpr = dom.createElementNS(NS, "w:rPr")
            r.insertBefore(rpr, r.firstChild)
        us = rpr.getElementsByTagNameNS(NS, "u")
        if us:
            us[0].setAttributeNS(NS, "w:val", "single")
        else:
            uel = dom.createElementNS(NS, "w:u")
            uel.setAttributeNS(NS, "w:val", "single")
            rpr.appendChild(uel)
        run_count += 1
    headline_count += 1

with open(path, "wb") as f:
    dom.writexml(f, encoding="ascii", newl="\n", addindent="  ")

print("underlined %d headline paragraphs (%d runs):" % (headline_count, run_count))
for h in headlines:
    print("  " + h)

import re, os, glob

# List files in unpacked dir
for root, dirs, files in os.walk('unpacked'):
    for f in files:
        print(os.path.join(root, f))
print('---')

with open('unpacked/word/document.xml', encoding='utf-8') as fh:
    xml = fh.read()

# Find all paragraphs and their pStyle values
paras = re.findall(r'<w:p\b.*?</w:p>', xml, re.S)
print(f'total paragraphs: {len(paras)}')
for i, p in enumerate(paras):
    style = re.search(r'<w:pStyle w:val="([^"]+)"', p)
    text = ''.join(re.findall(r'<w:t[^>]*>([^<]*)</w:t>', p))
    if style or text.strip():
        print(f'[{i}] style={style.group(1) if style else None!r} text={text!r}')
